edit.description: renderSchemaForPrompt: one comment-aware separator, reached at the core-to-extension junction too

summary: renderSchemaForPrompt appends the core/extension separator past observedFiles' trailing `//` comment; share the comment-aware separator

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: A render carrying any extension separates the last core line before its trailing `// ` comment, not after it; the bare-core snapshot is unchanged.
tests: the list separator lands before the last core field's trailing line comment when an extension follows
notes: Verified on disk: src/PendingSchema.ts:586 joins `,` onto coreLines, whose last line (:581) ends in a `// ` comment — rendered output reads `omit it otherwise.,` and the first extension field follows with no separator. The extension-to-extension path already handles this at :563-565; that detection is not shared with the junction beside it.
